process.label: HOW WE SHIP
process.supporting: A structured 5-stage lifecycle engineered for high durability under harsh field conditions and bandwidth limits.

01.title: Discover & Map
01.description: We audit your real-world operational bottlenecks: field paper trails, payment reconciliation issues, and stakeholder constraints across Hargeisa and beyond.

02.title: Design & Prototype
02.description: We craft high-density, ergonomic UIs with instant feedback. Every screen is designed for high sun visibility, bilingual typography, and 44px+ touch targets.

03.title: Engineer & Integrate
03.description: We build with modern frameworks (Laravel, Filament, Flutter, .NET, Next.js). We wire direct local APIs for ZAAD, eDahab, GIS maps, and offline caches.

04.title: Launch & Field-Test
04.description: We test with actual field supervisors, remote teachers, or public users under poor 3G connections. We tune query performance to sub-100ms.

05.title: Operate & Scale
05.description: Software is a living asset. We monitor infrastructure health, handle ministerial compliance updates, patch security, and expand feature modules.
